new: Sharp text in VR again: one VR session that closed by itself (or a reload in its first seconds) used to switch the sharp panels and menu off for good, in AR too. Now it takes two in a row, only VR, and an old switch-off is forgotten once.
The cards in a headset: the coloured bar along the top now follows the card's rounded corners (the Stories screen, Experiments and a room's station cards).
What is new: Later is now the main button; Got it is the quieter one on the right.

Moving with the sticks: Turn: smooth (the default) turns you as long as you push the right stick, up to about 90 degrees a second. Turn: steps keeps the 30-degree flicks. On the menu's Settings tab, under Moving with the sticks; the studio follows it too.
From v201 and v200, not yet tried: a studio character worn with any mix of devices, and the tracker guide.
test: In VR (a story, then the menu): is the text as sharp as in AR? The Settings tab's Sharp text line should say how many layers are shown. If not, take a note: its log now says what the session asked for and got.
The Stories screen in a headset: are the cards' top corners clean now?
Turn smoothly with the right stick in a story and in the studio. Is the speed comfortable? Then try Turn: steps.
v201: wear a studio character with a few mixes (a headset alone, a headset and foot trackers). Do the lines and the list look right, and do empty hands hang?
v200: Experiments, Tracker guide: walk the stands. Can you read the signs and the pucks' tags?
untested: All of this on a headset: sharp text in VR (only a pretend headset was tried), the smooth turn's comfort and speed, the cards' corners at reading distance.
v201 and v200 with real trackers, a real headset and controllers; the tracker guide's spoken lines are still not rendered.
